scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The proof is symbolic and depends only on the published norm formula, the published strong-uniqueness property of the ambient space, and the classical nonuniqueness of the isometric predual of \(\ell_1\). No computational experiment is used.
limitations: The classification concerns only canonical coordinate subspaces of the explicit renormed \(\ell_1\) example.
No classification of arbitrary weak-* closed complemented subspaces or arbitrary projections is claimed.
The infinite-subspace dichotomy does not assert an analogous distinction for finite coordinate sets.

title: A coordinate-subspace dichotomy inside a strongly unique-predual renorming of \(\ell_1\)
